rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a unique account before accessing orders. It confirmed the exact items and order for the return and obtained explicit user confirmation before performing the return write. The return was executed on the correct order and items (air purifier item_id 9534205511 and robotic vacuum item_id 6259501109), and the tool response shows the order moved to return requested with the correct return payment method. The agent accurately computed and communicated the refund total ($1,126.04) and correctly declined to guarantee a 3-day refund while providing a reasonable timeframe. It also correctly calculated the total amount paid for the remaining items ($1,497.65). No unsupported claims about the order, no actions on the wrong user, and no writes without confirmation. All steps align with the policy.
